title: VPN Access Fails After Password Rotation
problem: User updated corporate password but VPN client keeps rejecting credentials and cannot connect remotely.
solution: Clear cached credentials in the VPN client, sign out of SSO session, and re-authenticate with the new password.

title: Node Build Fails on CI with Out-of-Memory
problem: A frontend build intermittently fails in CI due to JavaScript heap out-of-memory errors.
solution: Increase Node memory with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 and split the build into smaller chunks.

title: Dependency issues in charting-service
problem: Having seemingly random issues when trying to pull in dependencies into charting-service in IntelliJ by syncing or reloading maven projects. The issue might be seen only in IntelliJ, or it may also happen at the command-line.
solution:
The solution is to add the following settings.xml to your /Users/<your username>/.m2/ directory: 

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<settings xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/SETTINGS/1.1.0"
          xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/SETTINGS/1.1.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/settings-1.1.0.xsd"
          xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>release</id>
            <repositories>
                <repository>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>false</enabled>
                    </snapshots>
                    <id>central</id>
                    <name>libs-release</name>
                    <url>https://artifactory.oci.oraclecorp.com/libs-release</url>
                </repository>
            </repositories>
            <pluginRepositories>
                <pluginRepository>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>false</enabled>
                    </snapshots>
                    <id>central</id>
                    <name>plugins-release</name>
                    <url>https://artifactory.oci.oraclecorp.com/plugins-release</url>
                </pluginRepository>
            </pluginRepositories>
        </profile>

        <profile>
            <id>snapshot</id>
            <repositories>
                <repository>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>false</enabled>
                    </snapshots>
                    <id>libs-release</id>
                    <name>libs-release</name>
                    <url>https://artifactory.oci.oraclecorp.com/libs-release</url>
                </repository>
                <repository>
                    <snapshots/>
                    <id>snapshots</id>
                    <name>libs-snapshot</name>
                    <url>https://artifactory.oci.oraclecorp.com/libs-snapshot</url>
                </repository>
            </repositories>
            <pluginRepositories>
                <pluginRepository>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>false</enabled>
                    </snapshots>
                    <id>central</id>
                    <name>plugins-release</name>
                    <url>https://artifactory.oci.oraclecorp.com/libs-release</url>
                </pluginRepository>
                <pluginRepository>
                    <snapshots/>
                    <id>snapshots</id>
                    <name>plugins-snapshot</name>
                    <url>https://artifactory.oci.oraclecorp.com/libs-snapshot</url>
                </pluginRepository>
            </pluginRepositories>
        </profile>
    </profiles>
    <activeProfiles>
        <activeProfile>snapshot</activeProfile>
    </activeProfiles>
</settings>
